LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_Connect_Desc: Send a colonist to open a channel to the Kwazaari. They buy ultra and beyond tech for scrip, and sell favors for scrip.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_Sell_Tip: Kwazaari appreciate delivering ultra and beyond tech to them
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_Spend_Tip: You can spend scrip you earned for selling technology on favors
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_NothingToSell: No ultra or beyond tech in the home area.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_Sold: The Kwazaari took the goods. You earned {0}.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_FavorNeedsMod: Requires a DLC that is not active.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_InDebt: You owe the Kwazaari scrip. Sell technology to pay off the debt first.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_LoanActive: Kwazaari soldiers are already on loan.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_NoLandingSpot: No open, roofless space for a shuttle to land.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_Delivered: Kwazaari drop pods are coming down.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_LoanArrivalText: A Kwazaari shuttle is landing with {0} soldiers. They are yours to command for {1}, then a shuttle will come to take them back.\n\nTheir gear stays theirs: it cannot be stripped or swapped.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_PickupText: The Kwazaari shuttle has come for its soldiers. It leaves in {0}. Every soldier who does not board it costs {1} scrip.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_LoanLostText: {0} lent soldier(s) did not return with the shuttle. The Kwazaari charged {1} scrip. Your balance is now {2} scrip.\n\nAny who survived stay with you.
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_GearLocked: Kwazaari soldiers keep their own gear.
LanguageData.BOR_KwazaariFireModeDesc: Program the core of each kwazaari bolt before it fires. Click to switch to the next mode, or right-click to pick one. Switching takes {0} seconds and can be interrupted.
LanguageData.BOR_KwazaariFireMode_NormalDesc: A plain bolt. It does full damage and uses one cartridge.
LanguageData.BOR_KwazaariFireMode_BoomDesc: The bolt hits for less, then the core bursts like a small grenade and hurts anyone close to the target. Each shot uses 10 cartridges.
LanguageData.BOR_KwazaariFireMode_EMPDesc: The bolt does almost no damage. Once it hits, the core releases an EMP pulse into the target that stuns mechanoids and turrets, and it can break a shield belt. Each shot uses 4 cartridges.
LanguageData.BOR_KwazaariFireMode_BurnDesc: The bolt hits for less and burns the target. It may set them on fire. Each shot uses 4 cartridges.
